factoryName.metadata: Nombre de instancia de Data Factory

properties.description: Carga fechas de silver.races hacia gold.dim_date. Ajustar referencia del dataset Silver al nombre real en ADF.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT DISTINCT CAST(YEAR(d.full_date) * 10000 + MONTH(d.full_date) * 100 + DAY(d.full_date) AS int) AS date_sk, d.full_date, CAST(YEAR(d.full_date) AS smallint) AS [year], CONCAT((YEAR(d.full_date) / 10) * 10, \'s\') AS decade, CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER, d.full_date) AS tinyint) AS [quarter], CAST(MONTH(d.full_date) AS tinyint) AS [month], CHOOSE(MONTH(d.full_date), \'Enero\',\'Febrero\',\'Marzo\',\'Abril\',\'Mayo\',\'Junio\',\'Julio\',\'Agosto\',\'Septiembre\',\'Octubre\',\'Noviembre\',\'Diciembre\') AS month_name, CHOOSE((DATEDIFF(DAY, \'19000101\', d.full_date) % 7 + 7) % 7 + 1, \'Lunes\',\'Martes\',\'Miercoles\',\'Jueves\',\'Viernes\',\'Sabado\',\'Domingo\') AS day_of_week FROM (SELECT TRY_CONVERT(date, [date]) AS full_date FROM silver.races) d WHERE d.full_date IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_date existing WHERE existing.full_date = d.full_date)',

properties.description: Carga dim_race desde silver.races con SQL Source. Verificar columnas raceId, year, round, name, date, time y nombre del dataset Silver. race_sk es IDENTITY y no se envía.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) AS race_id, TRY_CONVERT(smallint, r.[year]) AS season_year, TRY_CONVERT(tinyint, r.[round]) AS round_number, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.[name])), 120) AS race_name, TRY_CONVERT(date, r.[date]) AS race_date, TRY_CONVERT(time(0), NULLIF(CAST(r.[time] AS varchar(50)), \'\\N\')) AS race_time_utc FROM silver.races r WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, r.[year]) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(tinyint, r.[round]) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.[name])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(date, r.[date]) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_race g WHERE g.race_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId))',

properties.description: Carga inicial de pilotos desde silver.drivers a gold.dim_driver. Supone nombres originales de columnas Ergast en Silver. driver_sk es IDENTITY. Validar Source y Sink en ADF.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId) AS driver_id, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.driverRef, \'\\N\'), \'Unknown\'))), 60) AS driver_ref, TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(d.[number] AS varchar(30)), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS permanent_number, LEFT(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.code)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), 3) AS driver_code, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), 60) AS forename, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname)), 60) AS surname, LEFT(CONCAT(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), \' \', LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname))), 125) AS full_name, TRY_CONVERT(date, NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(d.dob AS varchar(30)), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS dob, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.nationality)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS nationality FROM silver.drivers d WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.forename)), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.surname)), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_driver g WHERE g.driver_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, d.driverId))',

properties.description: Carga constructores Silver a Gold. Usa Source SQL; constructor_sk es IDENTITY. Verificar nombres de columnas Silver y referencias de datasets.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId) AS constructor_id, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.constructorRef)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS constructor_ref, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])), 100) AS constructor_name, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.nationality)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'), 60) AS nationality FROM silver.constructors c WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_constructor g WHERE g.constructor_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, c.constructorId))',

properties.description: Carga circuitos desde silver.circuits a gold.dim_circuit. Mantiene latitud y longitud para Tableau. Validar nombres de columnas y datasets en ADF.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int,c.circuitId) AS circuit_id, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.circuitRef)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'),60) AS circuit_ref, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])),120) AS circuit_name, LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[location])), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'),80) AS [location], LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.country)), \'\\N\'), \'\'), \'Unknown\'),60) AS country, TRY_CONVERT(decimal(9,6),NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(c.lat AS varchar(40)), \'\\N\'),\'\')) AS latitude, TRY_CONVERT(decimal(9,6),NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(c.lng AS varchar(40)), \'\\N\'),\'\')) AS longitude, TRY_CONVERT(int,NULLIF(NULLIF(CAST(c.alt AS varchar(40)), \'\\N\'),\'\')) AS altitude_m FROM silver.circuits c WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int,c.circuitId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.[name])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_circuit g WHERE g.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,c.circuitId))',

properties.description: Carga estados de resultados de silver.status a gold.dim_status. Clasificacion heuristica de estados para Tableau; validar categorias en vista previa.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) AS status_id, LEFT(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])), 80) AS status_description, CASE WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status]))) = \'finished\' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])) LIKE \'+% Lap%\' THEN \'Finished\' WHEN LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%accident%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%collision%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%spun off%\' THEN \'Accident\' WHEN LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%engine%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%gearbox%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%transmission%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%hydraulic%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%electrical%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%brake%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%suspension%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%clutch%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%overheat%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%mechanical%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%turbo%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%oil%\' OR LOWER(s.[status]) LIKE \'%fuel%\' THEN \'Mechanical\' ELSE \'Other\' END AS status_category, CAST(CASE WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status]))) = \'finished\' OR LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])) LIKE \'+% Lap%\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS is_finished_flag FROM silver.status s WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[status])), \'\') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.dim_status g WHERE g.status_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId))',

properties.description: Carga resultados de Silver a Gold usando claves sustitutas de las 6 dimensiones. Ejecutar después de cargar dimensiones. Requiere DS_Silver_Results y DS_Gold_Fact_RaceResults.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT  TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId) AS result_id,  dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, ds.status_sk,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) AS grid_position,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30), s.position))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS final_position,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) AS position_order,  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2), s.points) AS points,  TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.laps) AS laps_completed,  TRY_CONVERT(bigint, NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.milliseconds))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS race_time_ms,  CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL  THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)), TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS fastest_lap_ms,  TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,3), NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50), s.fastestLapSpeed))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS fastest_lap_speed_kph,  CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, s.positionOrder) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_win,  CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int, s.positionOrder) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_podium,  CAST(CASE WHEN ds.is_finished_flag = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tinyint) AS is_dnf,  CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) > 0 AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) - TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) AS smallint) END AS positions_gained,  CASE WHEN dv.dob IS NOT NULL AND dr.race_date >= dv.dob THEN CAST(DATEDIFF(day, dv.dob, dr.race_date) / 365.2425 AS decimal(4,1)) END AS driver_age_at_race FROM silver.results s INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date = dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int, r.raceId) = dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, r.circuitId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_status ds ON ds.status_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.statusId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.grid) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL  AND TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2), s.points) >= 0  AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint, s.laps) IS NOT NULL  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_race_results f WHERE f.result_id = TRY_CONVERT(int, s.resultId))',

properties.description: Borrador: validar nombres de columnas contra capa_gold_parte1.sql antes de ejecutar. Source SQL silver.pit_stops; sink Gold.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,p.[stop]) AS stop_number, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,p.lap) AS lap_number, CONVERT(varchar(20),p.[time]) AS stop_time, TRY_CONVERT(int,p.milliseconds) AS duration_ms, CAST(TRY_CONVERT(decimal(15,3),p.milliseconds)/1000.0 AS decimal(10,3)) AS duration_seconds FROM silver.pit_stops p INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,p.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date=dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,p.driverId) INNER JOIN silver.results sr ON TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.raceId)=TRY_CONVERT(int,p.raceId) AND TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.driverId)=TRY_CONVERT(int,p.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int,r.raceId)=dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,r.circuitId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(smallint,p.[stop]) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,p.lap) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(int,p.milliseconds)>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_pit_stops f WHERE f.race_sk=dr.race_sk AND f.driver_sk=dv.driver_sk AND f.stop_number=TRY_CONVERT(smallint,p.[stop]))',

properties.description: Mapping Data Flow para gold.fact_qualifying; revisar esquema y datasets antes de ejecutar.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int,q.qualifyId) AS qualify_id, dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, TRY_CONVERT(smallint, NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(20),q.[number]))),\'\\N\'),\'\')) AS car_number, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,q.[position]) AS qualifying_position, t.q1_ms, t.q2_ms, t.q3_ms, (SELECT MIN(v) FROM (VALUES(t.q1_ms),(t.q2_ms),(t.q3_ms)) AS times(v)) AS best_qualifying_ms, CAST(CASE WHEN t.q2_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS reached_q2, CAST(CASE WHEN t.q3_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS reached_q3, CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(smallint,q.[position])=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_pole_position FROM silver.qualifying q INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,q.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date=dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,q.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,q.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int,r.raceId)=dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,r.circuitId) CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q1]))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)), TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q1]))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS q1_ms, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q2]))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)), TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q2]))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS q2_ms, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q3]))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond, CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)), TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(40), q.[q3]))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS q3_ms) t WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int,q.qualifyId) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,q.[position])>=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_qualifying f WHERE f.qualify_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,q.qualifyId))',

properties.description: Silver sprint_results a Gold. Requiere dimensiones Gold cargadas. SQL source y sink con mapeo explicito; no inserta IDENTITY ni _loaded_at.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId) AS sprint_result_id, dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, ds.status_sk, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid) AS grid_position, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(30),s.position))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS final_position, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) AS position_order, TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2),s.points) AS points, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.laps) AS laps_completed, TRY_CONVERT(bigint,NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.milliseconds))), \'\\N\'), \'\')) AS sprint_time_ms, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(time(3), CONCAT(\'00:\', NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\'))) IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(millisecond,CAST(\'00:00:00.000\' AS time(3)),TRY_CONVERT(time(3),CONCAT(\'00:\',NULLIF(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONVERT(varchar(50),s.fastestLapTime))), \'\\N\'), \'\')))) END AS fastest_lap_ms, CAST(CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(int,s.positionOrder)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS tinyint) AS is_sprint_win, CAST(CASE WHEN ds.is_finished_flag=1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tinyint) AS is_dnf, CASE WHEN TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid)>0 THEN CAST(TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid)-TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) AS smallint) END AS positions_gained FROM silver.sprint_results s INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date=dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int,r.raceId)=dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,r.circuitId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_status ds ON ds.status_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.statusId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.grid) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.positionOrder) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CONVERT(decimal(6,2),s.points)>=0 AND TRY_CONVERT(smallint,s.laps) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_sprint_results f WHERE f.sprint_result_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,s.resultId))',

properties.description: BORRADOR: verificar nombres de columnas con gold.fact_lap_times antes de ejecutar el Sink. Carga silver.lap_times con claves Gold.

scriptLines: query: 'SELECT dr.race_sk, dd.date_sk, dv.driver_sk, dc.constructor_sk, ci.circuit_sk, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,l.lap) AS lap_number, TRY_CONVERT(smallint,l.[position]) AS lap_position, TRY_CONVERT(int,l.milliseconds) AS lap_time_ms, CAST(TRY_CONVERT(decimal(15,3),l.milliseconds)/1000.0 AS decimal(10,3)) AS lap_time_seconds FROM silver.lap_times l INNER JOIN gold.dim_race dr ON dr.race_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,l.raceId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_date dd ON dd.full_date=dr.race_date INNER JOIN gold.dim_driver dv ON dv.driver_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,l.driverId) INNER JOIN silver.results sr ON TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.raceId)=TRY_CONVERT(int,l.raceId) AND TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.driverId)=TRY_CONVERT(int,l.driverId) INNER JOIN gold.dim_constructor dc ON dc.constructor_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,sr.constructorId) INNER JOIN silver.races r ON TRY_CONVERT(int,r.raceId)=dr.race_id INNER JOIN gold.dim_circuit ci ON ci.circuit_id=TRY_CONVERT(int,r.circuitId) WHERE TRY_CONVERT(smallint,l.lap)>0 AND TRY_CONVERT(int,l.milliseconds)>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gold.fact_lap_times f WHERE f.race_sk=dr.race_sk AND f.driver_sk=dv.driver_sk AND f.lap_number=TRY_CONVERT(smallint,l.lap))',
